'''Mark Birkinshaw''' (1954–2023) was a British physicist who held the William P. Coldrick chair in [[Cosmology]] and [[Astrophysics]] at the [[University of Bristol]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20200712210350/http://www.bristol.ac.uk/physics/people/mark-birkinshaw/overview.html Former University of Bristol profile]</ref> He was the first to detect the [[Sunyaev–Zel'dovich effect]].<ref>[https://arxiv.org/abs/astro-ph/9808050 The Sunyaev-Zel'dovich Effect]</ref> Birkinshaw died in 2023.<ref>{{cite web |title=R.I.P. Mark Birkinshaw (1954–2023) |url=https://telescoper.blog/2023/08/17/r-i-p-mark-birkinshaw-1954-2023/ |website=In the Dark |access-date=17 August 2023 |language=en |date=17 August 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Mark Birkinshaw (Vice-President) has sadly passed away – Bristol Astronomical Society |url=https://bristolastrosoc.org.uk/prof-mark-birkinshaw-vice-president-has-sadly-passed-away/ |access-date=17 August 2023 |date=2 August 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Tribute to Mark Birkinshaw, 1954 – 2023 |url=https://markbirkinshaw.muchloved.com/ |website=Tribute to Mark Birkinshaw, 1954 – 2023}}</ref>
